persona: Oscar is a cross-border customs broker in San Diego, California, managing the flow of industrial components through the Otay Mesa Port of Entry. He navigates the complexities of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement and the specific security protocols of U.S. Customs and Border Protection, ensuring that high-volume shipments of electronics and medical devices are accurately classified and documented to avoid delays at one of the nation's busiest commercial crossings.
task: Write an email to the supplier notifying them which electronics shipment is delayed by secondary inspection at Otay Mesa.
